name: Injoku Shinsatsushitsu ~Aiyoku no Karute~

source:
Hidetoshi is a man, who had an accident and was hospitalized. There is a beautiful nurse, Miyuki. He is happy to be able to see her every day. Every afternoon, he has a daily checkup by a doctor in charge, Azusa. She is also beautiful and has big breasts. One day, he is walking in the hospital, he hears someone gasping in the examination room. He looks in, and finds Miyuki and Azusa having sex. On the next day, he tells Azusa about what he saw yesterday to blackmail, but she accepts the fact and offers him, "Please insult Miyuki and make her a sex slave." And she gives him a blowjob.... His indecent life in hospital just starts...
